summary: Tested Google-account integration with seeded Mongo sessions (cookie + Bearer). Backend: 26 pytest cases (15 existing + 11 new in test_accounts_extended.py), 25 pass. The 1 failure is a security finding: GET /api/rooms/{code} returns current_word. Frontend (Playwright, desktop + mobile): all requested flows passed. Guest gating: lock badges, login-required on 6 routes, Solo with name + guest-note, public leaderboard. The Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com with redirect=origin+'/'. Nickname setup appears first after login (duplicate gives a 409 message, invalid gives a 400 message, saving lands in the app). Daily: no name input, 2x badge, dictionary toast, 5000 on the 1st try and 3600 on the 2nd. Partial and completed progress are restored on a second browser context. Room: create asks only the room name; joining by code and by direct /room/CODE auto-join both work; the host view is decided by account (checked in a fresh context); a win of 1800 was added on top of the seeded 1000, giving 2800. Chat shows nicknames with own messages on the right. Cumulative total went 1000 -> 2800 -> 6400 (room + daily). Profile values all matched; nickname edit works. Overall leaderboard is sorted and shows '(sən)'. Solo signed-in resumes and does not change total_points. Host Panel: wrong code is rejected and 'Elnur' opens it. Logout gives 401 on /auth/me.

critical.issue: Response includes current_word (and host_code) for anyone. Players' RoomView polls this every few seconds, so the secret word can be read in DevTools > Network. Points now go to the account and the overall leaderboard, so this lets players cheat.

minor.issue: These only check host_code=='Elnur'. They need no login and do not check room.host_user_id, so any signed-in user, or even an anonymous request, can control any room. The 'host decided by account' rule is only enforced in the UI.
No ownership check: anyone who has a game_id can guess on another user's signed-in solo game (low impact because solo points do not count).
Does not check that the room exists or that the sender is a member/host of the room.

Changing the nickname does not update the player_name already stored in daily_games/room_players, so today's daily leaderboard and the room leaderboards keep showing the old nickname. There is also no unique index on nickname_lower, so two concurrent saves of the same nickname could both succeed.
Only deletes the session found in the cookie; a Bearer-only client cannot log out on the server.

issues: The 'Ümumi Liderlik' title wraps to 2 lines and the trophy icon sits right against the Geri button; stack the header or shrink the title
The page background shows a grey/beige bleed behind the list on mobile, which looks different from the other dark pages
No logout/switch-account option, so a user who signed in with the wrong Google account is stuck on this screen
Many leftover TEST_* rooms from earlier iterations are still 'active' (not created in this run)

action_items: Strip current_word and host_code from GET /api/rooms/{code} for non-hosts (optional user dependency: return the word only when user_id == host_user_id, or only after the round ends)
Require get_player + room.host_user_id == user.user_id on the set-word/start-game/end-round/close/settings endpoints (keep the code check if wanted)
Optional: when the nickname changes, update player_name in today's daily_games and in room_players; add a unique index on users.nickname_lower
Optional: check ownership on solo/guess; check room existence/membership on chat/send
Fix the mobile leaderboard header layout and background; add a logout link on NicknameSetup
critical_code_review_comments: Room host authority is only in the UI: the backend trusts a shared static code that is also hardcoded in the frontend bundle (the hardcoding itself is accepted, but ownership should be checked with host_user_id now that accounts exist)

Possible double award: daily_game_guess/room_guess do read-modify-write without an atomic guard, so two parallel requests on the last guess could both award points (the UI submitting guard reduces this). Consider a conditional update on completed:false

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use cookie session_token (domain wordle-az-2.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, sameSite None) via add_cookies; a new browser context simulates a second device. Type guesses with page.keyboard.press per letter + Enter; use ASCII-only words from /api/words/random. An invalid word stays in the current row (the user must backspace). PlayerGameView shows waiting-screen when no round is active and player-game-view only during a round. Daily word is available from azerbaijani_words.get_daily_word() (do not print the dictionary). After fixes, re-run test_accounts_extended.py::test_room_get_does_not_leak_word, which should pass.
